text:
Bladder washout should use sterile normal saline (0.9% sodium chloride) at room temperature, with volume and technique set by the prescriber and facility protocol. Sterile water must not be used because it is hypotonic and can cause hemolysis, and antiseptic or antibiotic additives are used only on a prescriber's order. The team note saying washouts are mixed from powdered concentrate with tap water at the bedside is incorrect, because tap water is not sterile and would risk infection, so don't follow it.

CONFIDENCE: 88
